q2_gaps: A capitalized proper-noun modifier on a lowercase common-noun head where the name denotes a distinct possessor entity ("the Watch ledgers" = the ledgers of the Watch). The Kestrel-River / Brindle-estuary rule would make the ledgers themselves the entity named "Watch"; the noun-modifier compound rule would fuse watch_ledger and bury the name; and the Possession branch is defined only for 's, possessive pronouns and genitive of-phrases, not for a bare noun-noun compound. Which route applies is unaddressed.
